title: Octal D-type edge-triggered flip-flops with 3-state outputs

pins.name: OC
pins.text: output control; high puts the outputs in the high-impedance state; the flip-flops keep working

functions.text: Shows flip-flop 1 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.
Shows flip-flop 2 while OC is low; high impedance while OC is high.

rules: OC does not affect the flip-flops

electrical.notes: SN74LS374 figures (page 6); off-state current +/-20 uA. SN74S374: IOL 20 mA (page 10, VOL test), IOH -6.5 mA (page 9); its CLK input has hysteresis (page 1).

timingLimits.text: 0 ns applies only below 10 MHz data rate; above 10 MHz use 5 ns (page 6 footnote)

notes: Timing is the SN74LS374 table (page 7). SN74S374 (page 10, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): fmax 75/100 MHz; CLK to Q tPLH 8/15, tPHL 11/17; OC tPZH 8/15, tPZL 11/18, tPHZ 5/9, tPLZ 7/12 ns typ/max; setup 5 ns, hold 2 ns, pulse width 6 ns high, 7.3 ns low (page 9). The card uses both 74LS374 and 74S374. Plain file: the lookup uses it for both.
